🍽️🌎 It's time for a first taste of the 2026 EPCOT International Food & Wine Festival!

Disney superfans and NBA player Brook Lopez and former NBA player Robin Lopez join food creator @KarissaEats for a delicious challenge: can they identify some of the new dishes and returning fan favorites coming to this year's festival?

From savory bites to sweet treats and refreshing sips, they're putting their Disney food knowledge to the test while getting a sneak peek at select menu items guests can enjoy during EPCOT's culinary celebration.

Which dish would you be most excited to try? Let us know in the comments!

text:
Villains Grove at Oogie Boogie Bash Ambience | Disneyland Music & Ambience | 4K POV
Take a nighttime stroll through Villains Grove at Oogie Boogie Bash – A Disney Halloween Party and immerse yourself in the ethereal sights and sounds.

Experience the haunting sights, sounds, music, and atmosphere of this immersive Halloween walkthrough trail inspired by some of Disney's most infamous villains. Located within the transformed Redwood Creek Challenge Trail during Oogie Boogie Bash at Disney California Adventure park, Villains Grove turns a familiar California Adventure setting into a mesmerizing realm filled with glowing forests, mysterious pathways, stunning projections, and hauntingly beautiful scenescapes.

Whether you're planning your next visit, reminiscing about Oogie Boogie Bash, or looking for Disney Parks background music and ambience, this full POV video is the perfect way to bring the magic and Halloween time home.

Oogie Boogie Bash – A Disney Halloween Party is a separately ticketed event on select dates at Disneyland Resort. Learn more at Disneyland.com/OogieBoogieBash.
